changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hts_client AS SELECT hts.id, CAST(pp.uuid AS text) AS person_uuid, hts.date_of_visit AS date_visit, CASE WHEN hts.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = 'STI_HIV_RESULT_POSITIVE' THEN 'Positive' WHEN hts.observation->>'initialHivTest' = 'STI_HIV_RESULT_POSITIVE' AND COALESCE(hts.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest', '') = '' THEN 'Positive' WHEN hts.observation->>'confirmatoryHivTest' = 'STI_HIV_RESULT_NEGATIVE' OR hts.observation->>'initialHivTest' = 'STI_HIV_RESULT_NEGATIVE' THEN 'Negative' ELSE '' END AS hiv_test_result, hts.facility_id AS facility_id, hts.archived AS archived FROM hts_encounter hts JOIN patient_person pp ON pp.id = hts.patient_id WHERE hts.archived = false;
